long_biography.plain_text:
Mansard Riyadh, a Radisson Collection Hotel, is Sheikh Saleh Abdulaziz Al Remaizan’s clearest current business asset. He brought Radisson Hotel Group into the development as operating partner, with the project combining conventional hotel rooms, serviced apartments and duplex villas in northern Riyadh.

Al Remaizan set an emphasis on elegant surroundings and attentive service when the partnership was announced. The property opened in 2022 with a Paris-inspired roofline, interiors by Hirsch Bedner Associates and locally commissioned artwork. Its structure separates his ownership and development role from Radisson’s management of the hospitality brand.
